source: Sprint task sheet + GSC + Odoo CRM post-sprint verification
summary: Sprint 1 complete. 2 of 3 technical fixes recovered. 1 blog post published and ranking. Off-page outreach had 1 successful placement.

technical_tasks.title: Title tag + meta description optimization — /odoo-crm-module
technical_tasks.evidence: Position improved from 10.4 to 7.8 (+2.6). Impressions up 27%. CTR improved 21%. GSC Insights no longer flags this page.
technical_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Tactic validated. On-page title/meta optimization produced measurable position improvement within 15 days. Repeat this approach for underperforming pages.

technical_tasks.title: Service + FAQ schema markup — /odoo-implementation-services
technical_tasks.evidence: Position moved from 6.8 to 6.2 (slight improvement). Impressions up 6%. Schema not yet triggering rich results consistently — may need 1 more cycle.
technical_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Schema markup tactic inconclusive — early positive signal but needs full 90-day cooldown. Page in cooldown until 2026-07-04. Do not re-touch.

technical_tasks.title: Internal linking from blog to /odoo-manufacturing
technical_tasks.evidence: Position continued to drop from 7 to 11 despite internal links added. Root cause likely off-page — ksolves.com earned 5+ backlinks pointing to their manufacturing page.
technical_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Internal link addition insufficient when competitor is actively earning authoritative backlinks. Need backlink strategy + content quality upgrade for this page, not just internal links.

content_tasks.title: Blog post: Odoo CRM Customization in 2026 — Step-by-Step for Manufacturers
content_tasks.author: Uttam
content_tasks.evidence: Article indexed within 3 days. Impressions: 840 in first 15 days. Position: 18.2 for primary keyword. Contributing to overall /odoo-crm-module page authority.
content_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Tactic validated. 2100-word expert-authored blog on CRM customization indexed quickly and gaining impressions. Repeat: expert-authored, 2000+ word, specific how-to format for manufacturing audience.

content_tasks.title: Blog post: Odoo vs SAP for Mid-Market Indian Manufacturers
content_tasks.author: Nandeep
content_tasks.evidence: Article indexed, 520 impressions in 15 days. Position: 24.1 for primary keyword. Lower velocity than CRM post — comparison format may take longer to establish authority.
content_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Tactic validated but slower to gain traction than expected. Comparison articles need more authoritative backlinks to rank faster. Next sprint: secure 1-2 backlinks to this page.

offpage_tasks.title: Guest post — analyticsinsight.net
offpage_tasks.evidence: Article published: 'How Indian Manufacturers Are Using Odoo ERP to Cut Costs in 2026'. DA 62. 1 contextual backlink to /odoo-manufacturing. Link active.
offpage_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Guest post on analyticsinsight.net successful. Editor is Priya Sharma (priya@analyticsinsight.net). Relationship established. Pitch follow-up in 6 weeks viable.

offpage_tasks.title: Backlink outreach — techcircle.in
offpage_tasks.evidence: Cold email to editorial@techcircle.in — no response after 15 days.
offpage_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Cold email to techcircle.in unsuccessful. Note: cybrosys.com earned a techcircle.in backlink this cycle — they likely pitched a data story, not a cold link request. Pivot to data-story angle. Do not repeat cold email.

offpage_tasks.title: Quora answers — 4 answers on Odoo manufacturing + CRM questions
offpage_tasks.evidence: 4 answers published. Combined: 380 views in 15 days, 12 organic referral sessions to site. 1 answer (Odoo manufacturing question) ranking at position 7 on Google for the Quora thread URL.
offpage_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Quora answers produced measurable referral traffic. The manufacturing-focused answer ranked on Google. Strategy: continue Quora for manufacturing + CRM questions. Ensure answers are 400+ words with one internal link.

offpage_tasks.title: Reddit post — r/Odoo discussion on manufacturing deployment learnings
offpage_tasks.evidence: Post received 48 upvotes, 14 comments, 6 organic site visits. No direct lead attribution but brand visibility in Odoo community.
offpage_tasks.verdict_for_section_10: Reddit r/Odoo community receptive to practical case study format. No self-promotion in post — technical insights only. Repeat this format. Do not include direct promotional links.
